description: This file defines a React functional component named DeviceList that renders a list of devices with filtering, sorting, and delete functionality. It interacts with external API functions and manages UI state.

methods.name: DeviceList
methods.description: React functional component that displays and manages a list of devices, including filtering, sorting, and deletion.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Fetches device data from the API based on current filter and sort states.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Handles deletion of a device after user confirmation and refreshes the device list.
